name: Salmonella at Nanometre Resolution
description: A living Salmonella cell in 3D at true scale (1 unit = 1 nm), swimming in a liquid medium with drifting debris and a microscope-like focal plane. Orbit, zoom and fly like a submarine down to the flagellar motor with its rotating C-ring, stators and helical filament, a porin’s β-barrels, a K⁺ channel passing ions, and a rotating ATP synthase. Each view has a one-page micro-textbook chapter (the book symbol), with figures taken from the live model and a drug-target box. Hidden control panel at the right edge; runs offline in the browser.
